asymmetries.summary: Preview backends give derived gradients through grad_options and trace.derived_grads (tf graph-only captures refuse grad_options; grad_options cannot combine with intervene on paddle, tf or mlx), while true backward capture exists only on torch.

tl.extract is a thin sugar with keywords model, x, layers and detach_saved_activations only: it takes no backend, halt, recipes, echo, profile, grouping or episode, while tl.trace takes all of them (extract_dataset adds intervene and disk output). Cells citing this: backend x extract, episode x extract, extract x halt, extract x recipes, extract x reporting.
run(inputs=, fast=True) and runnable replay work on torch; preview backends and loaded non-torch artifacts report unsupported_backend_replay.
fork().do needs capture=CaptureOptions(intervention_ready=True), and preview backends refuse the capture= keyword, so post-hoc edits exist on torch only.
halt= works on torch, Paddle (live) and MLX (static-label) but jax, tinygrad and tf refuse it typed.
intervene= works fully on torch, as static-label rules on MLX and eager TF, as a helper subset (zero_ablate, scale, add, replace_with) on Paddle, and is refused by jax, tinygrad and graph-only TF.
recipes= attaches facet recipes on torch and Paddle; tf (and jax, tinygrad, mlx) refuse it typed.
Trace.run (re-execution) works on torch; preview traces cannot rerun and loaded non-torch artifacts cannot replay-validate.
Preview backends accept static-label save= selectors only, applied as a filter after a full capture (no memory saving); value-dependent predicates, lookback and save_budget are refused.

On the Trace path log_backward works after a halt and by default; tl.record installs gradient hooks only with backward_ready, save_grads or default_grad, refuses log_backward without them (recording_backward_not_requested), refuses it on a halted Recording (recording_backward_halted), and rejects save_grads with a disk-only store.

Gradient payloads stream to disk on trace.log_backward, but backward_ready=True refuses disk saves (backward_ready_conflict), chunk_size refuses backward capture, and a disk-only record refuses save_grads (predicate_storage_conflict).
Trace has to_pandas and xarray exports; Bundle offers none, and Bundle summary and agent_json refuse untyped with AttributeError (explain refuses typed with report_subject_unsupported).
Trace.save on a Trace accepts per-trace payload options and streaming storage; Trace.save on a Bundle accepts only level and overwrite and refuses the rest (bundle_save_option_unsupported).
Intervention marks draw on the dot layout; the rank layout (explicit or the automatic choice on high-cost graphs) omits standalone intervention hook nodes and warns.
Recording.draw renders a flat event graph and takes bare kwargs; Trace.draw takes VisualizationOptions, collapse, encodings and layouts. Cooked structure needs Recording.to_trace().
episode= is a tl.trace option; tl.record has no episode arm and refuses it with an untyped TypeError, which the composition table ledgers as a gap.

A plain episode product reruns as a fresh execution that drops the ledger to a travel note; a coupled product (episode with intervene) refuses run() on both engines with episode_coupled_replay_underivable.
Recording.to_pandas returns event columns; xarray, agent_json and analysis save are not offered on a Recording (agent_json and save refuse untyped).
run(fast=True) on a halted live trace refuses (N5; it silently succeeded before the gate); a loaded sparse artifact's run() still executes exactly the recorded prefix.

The guarded fast rerun applies staged module-selector (tl.module) specs; value replacements and non-module targets use the capture engine, and the explicit fast door refuses function targets (fast_rerun_target_unsupported).
fast= and carry_state exist only on the unified run(inputs=...) door; legacy run(model, x) refuses fast=True (run_fast_requires_inputs) and mixing option families refuses run_legacy_options_conflict.
fork() works on a halted trace but do() and push refuse (N5) because replay needs the full graph.
Trace has fork and do; a Recording has neither and fork refuses with an untyped AttributeError (ledgered gap).

do() on the replay/push engine handles activation, edge, parameter and region edits; the rerun engine refuses edge, parameter and region edits (edge_intervention_engine_unsupported, param_substitution_engine_unsupported, region_engine_unsupported).
A batch-coherent edit (permute_batch, self-sourced mean_fill) refuses chunked_replay_batch_coupling on a trace captured with chunk_size; the same edit is accepted on an unchunked trace.
Live rerun, refresh, push and run of a halted trace refuse (N5); loaded sparse run() is allowed and executes exactly the recorded prefix.

halt= composes with streaming to disk (tests/test_fastlog_halt.py::test_fastlog_halt_finalizes_disk_storage) but chunk_size refuses halt with a codeless ChunkedForwardConfigError, and stop_after refuses chunking (stop_after_chunked_conflict).

A bare label works on single-pass layers; on a multi-pass layer trace['label'] returns a Layer, op-level reads need a pass qualifier, and do and attach_hooks refuse the bare label (multipass_bare_label_ambiguous).

Finalized labels address ops for reads after a rerun, but a staged edit addressed by a postprocess label cannot be applied on rerun (rerun_staged_label_unmatchable) because live capture matches selectors before labels exist.

intervene= composes with streaming to disk (tests/test_surgery_live_injections.py::test_streamed_to_disk_intervene_capture_settles_and_loads) but chunk_size refuses intervene with a codeless ChunkedForwardConfigError.
tl.record captures repeated calls, but Recording.to_trace() refuses a multi-pass Recording (recording_multipass_not_convertible), so recurrent models cannot be cooked into a Trace.
tl.trace takes recipes=; tl.record takes no recipes keyword, so facet recipes cannot be attached on the sparse path.
trace(storage=tl.to_disk(...)) writes asynchronously by default and honors async_writes; tl.record streaming stays synchronous and refuses an explicit async_writes=True.
The same disk option is spelled storage= and streaming= on tl.trace and tl.record; both together refuse storage_argument_conflict, and a silent conflict case is ledgered (accepted then discarded).

The same capture concepts (random_seed, backward_ready, save_grads, detach_saved_activations) are flat keywords on tl.record but live inside capture=CaptureOptions(...) on tl.trace, and save= takes a selector, list or SaveOptions on trace but a predicate on record.
The model input is spelled input_args on trace, record and validate, x on extract and legacy run(model, x), inputs= on the unified run, and input_size= for declared shapes.
Which sites to keep is spelled save= on trace and record, layers on extract, and layers_to_save in CaptureOptions; using both save= and layers_to_save refuses save_selection_conflict.

Predicate type errors are twin codes with different lineages: tl.trace halt_predicate_type_invalid (ArgumentTypeError, TypeError) and intervention_predicate_type_invalid, versus tl.record recording_halt_predicate_type_invalid and recording_intervention_predicate_type_invalid (InvalidArgumentError, ValueError).
Early stop has two spellings: halt= (a predicate) and stop_after= (a selector or site); setting both refuses stop_after_halt_conflict, and only stop_after refuses chunking with its own code.
Disk output is spelled storage=tl.to_disk(path) on trace and record, output_dir= on extract_dataset, and bundle_path inside streaming options.

Rerun has two doors with different option sets: legacy run(model, x) applies a staged spec and re-arms capture predicates, unified run(inputs=...) refuses a staged spec (run_staged_spec_unapplied) unless fast=True, and carry_state, fast and until are unified-only.
`grad_transform` is both a `tl.trace` keyword and a field of `SaveOptions` and `RecordingOptions`, so one setting has two doors on the same call.
`show_model_graph`, `draw_backward` and `draw_combined` take `VisualizationOptions` and also flat keywords of the same names (`collapse`, `depth`, `node_style`, `view` ...).
`draw_combined` takes `show_buffer_layers` where `VisualizationOptions` and `Trace.draw` spell the setting `show_buffers`.
Gradient saving is `save_grads` on `CaptureOptions` and `RecordingOptions` but `save_raw_gradients` on `SaveOptions` and `RecordingOptions`.

Every options class is passed through a slot named after its group (`capture=`, `save=`, `replay=`, `streaming=`, `visualization=`) except `EchoOptions`, which `EchoSession` takes as `options=`; and `RecordingOptions` and `HtmlReportOptions` are public option classes that `tl.options` does not export.
